programmes.t: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "London"
programmes.d: In this episode Bones is back in his home city, London where he stuns locals with his mind reading, card trickery and disappearing skills.

programmes.t: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Night"
programmes.d: Bones is in Seoul, South Korea. He explores the city by night and performs a mixture of magic tricks, including a vanishing trick, coin tricks and card tricks.

programmes.t: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Traditional"
programmes.d: In this episode Bones is in South Korea, where he visits Taekwondo group, the K Tigers, a tarot card reader and reveals the secret to the perfect card shuffle.

programmes.t: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Garage Science"
programmes.d: Host Steve Spangler and his sidekick Higginsworth explore science experiments you can do in your own garage.

programmes.t: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Art Science"
programmes.d: Host Steve Spangler and his sidekick Higginsworth explore new ways to create art, using science.

programmes.t: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Classroom: Impossible"
programmes.d: Fourth grade teacher Sandra Sanchez has a problem – her class is a year behind in science after a season of virtual-only teaching.

programmes.t: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Museum Of Science, Boston #1"
programmes.d: Host Steve Spangler and his sidekick Higginsworth explore the Museum of Science, Boston, for new do-it-yourself science tricks and experiments.

programmes.t: Strip The City S2 - "Tokyo"
programmes.d: Experts strip away Tokyo to show the seismic engineering, massive storm drains, and advanced shock absorbers keeping this earthquake-prone city safe.

programmes.t: Strip The City S2 - "New Orleans"
programmes.d: The defenses of New Orleans are stripped back to expose the massive pumps, levees, and wetlands engineered to hold back Mississippi and Gulf storms.

programmes.t: The New Frontier S4 - "Hyabusa2"
programmes.d: The Japanese Asteroid sample return mission has reached its target and is surveying the space rock ready to dip down and take a sample. The return of asteroid material to Earth will aid scientists in the evolving asteroid planetary defense systems.

programmes.t: The New Frontier S4 - "Eyes to the Heavens"
programmes.d: Two new space telescopes are in orbit and completing their shakedown; Gaia and TESS they too will be joined by the James Webb Telescope. Together they will be opening up a whole new vista into time and space.

programmes.t: The New Frontier S4 - "Martian Attractions"
programmes.d: The Latest in Martian exploration from orbit and on the ground, new sources of water and planetary dust storms are a few of the stories unfolding on to the Red Planet.

programmes.t: The New Frontier S4 - "Cubesat"
programmes.d: Cubesats the tiny Satellites are growing in main stream popularity, they have even been sent to Mars with the Insight Mission.

programmes.t: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Animal Kingdom Meets Future Tech"
programmes.d: Host Chuck Pell goes to abandoned areas of Detroit where dog lovers are tracking thousands of strays… with drones.

programmes.t: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Future Of Learning"
programmes.d: Host Chuck Pell shows us a place that’s taking a hands-on approach to learning with robotic creatures.

programmes.t: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "Transforming How Things Are Made"
programmes.d: Host Chuck Pell will see how industrial diamonds are transforming manufacturing.

programmes.t: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Mars"
programmes.d: Beneath the red dust, CGI peels away Martian volcanoes and ice to reveal a once-Earth-like world and the challenges of future human missions.

programmes.t: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "The Sun"
programmes.d: By stripping away the Sun's boiling plasma layers, this CGI study reveals the nuclear core that fuels our world while tracking lethal solar storms.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Fun with the Sun"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at NASA’s next mission to send a spacecraft that will “touch” the sun.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Space Firsts"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli interviews several pioneers of space and discovers the determination and courage required to become the “first”.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Teaming up with NASA"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli visits the Sierra Nevada Corporation, which is building a spacecraft that can deliver cargo to and from the International Space Station.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Students of Space"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at students who are becoming involved with space exploration.

programmes.t: The New Frontier S4 - "Proving Einstein"
programmes.d: Some of the proof of Einstein’s theories had long been elusive, beyond the capabilities of technology, until now. It appears that Einstein is once again triumphant with the latest in deep space observations.

programmes.t: The New Frontier S4 - "Where Are All the Aliens?"
programmes.d: We’re looking hard, but the numbers aren’t stacking up, is life on other planets that hard to find? Even signals from an advanced race elude us. Maybe we really are alone in our neck of the galaxy!

programmes.t: The New Frontier S5 - "Star Light, Star Bright"
programmes.d: The two current science missions to our star; the sun have made great leaps forward in the science of how stars work, how they generate solar winds and how they affect their orbiting planets. This lets us look at other stars with great understanding.

programmes.t: The New Frontier S5 - "Moon Shine"
programmes.d: The International drive to return to the Moon is gathering pace. We look at what resources scientists and engineers are looking to extract from Lunar regolith and Martian soil.

programmes.t: Bright Now S1 - "The Wright Brothers: Bravery"
programmes.d: Just over 100 years ago, a pair of brothers looked at the sky and changed the world. They designed, built and flew the most ridiculous of inventions. How did two bicycle mechanics manage to succeed where the others had failed?

programmes.t: Women Make Science S1 - "Kyrgyzstan’s Space School"
programmes.d: In a country where girls are often kidnapped and forced to marry, a defiant all-girls space-tech school are building Kyrgyzstan’s first satellite.

programmes.t: Women Make Science S1 - "Ecuador’s Hidden Treasure"
programmes.d: Three women scientists take on Ecuador’s endangered spider monkeys and empower indigenous women, in a scientific area usually dominated by men.

programmes.t: Women Make Science S1 - "From The Lab To The Field"
programmes.d: From the laboratory to Africa, Dr Sheila Ochugboju takes her scientific knowledge to Kenya turning parasitic problems into scientific solutions.

programmes.t: Women Make Science S1 - "Dolphin Sanctuary"
programmes.d: Anastasia Miliou and her team of women scientist are building a sanctuary in Greece for dolphins released from captivity, the first of its kind.

programmes.t: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of McVitie's Biscuits"
programmes.d: The McVitie's factory in Carlisle, Cumbria, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favourite biscuits are made, 24 hours a day, in one of Britain's biggest factories and oldest biscuit factory in the world.

programmes.t: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of the Heinz Factory"
programmes.d: From making fresh spaghetti and mixing the top-secret ingredients for sauce, to giant automated cranes and the latest robots, join today’s Heinz factory workers alongside tomorrow’s machines, making cans of household favourites.

programmes.t: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Mr. Kipling Cakes"
programmes.d: Uncover the secrets of what it takes to make up to 5 million cakes a day, including French Fancies, Angel Slices and Bramley Apple Pies. Meet the engineers who keep the machines running 24/7, the workers making all the cakes, and the operators who spend their days with state-of-the-art robots.

programmes.t: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programmes.d: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programmes.t: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "World Ex"
programmes.d: Get excited with a digital car competition that pits teams from around the world against each other on digital race tracks, with the goal of protecting the environment.

programmes.t: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Energy Globe World Award 20th"
programmes.d: Follow behind the scenes of awards ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programmes.t: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "10 Genius Inventions – Part 1"
programmes.d: Learn about an award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programmes.t: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "10 Genius Inventions – Part 2"
programmes.d: Learn about an award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programmes.t: Digits S1 - "Connecting to the Future"
programmes.d: Muller escorts viewers to the physical heart of the Internet, revealing the very first message sent by UCLA professor Leonard Kleinrock, and demonstrating how Internet co-creators Vint Cerf and Bob Kahn devised a common protocol language.

programmes.t: Digits S1 - "Man vs. Machine"
programmes.d: Get a sneak peek into how the Internet of Things will soon dominate daily life. As Edward Snowden provocatively points out, “TV is a medium that you watch. The Internet is a medium that watches you as you watch it.”
